answer: Proof-of-Space-Time resists Sybil attacks by making each agent seal a unique, incompressible, key-bound dataset and answer random Merkle challenges before a tight timeout. Because recomputing unstored blocks exceeds that window, an attacker must dedicate real disk capacity and I/O throughput per identity. However, storage farms enjoy economies of scale, whereas mobile agents that wander over basalt ridges and juniper scrub lack the power and payload for large drives.
